html:
BiSeNet face parsing (Yu et al., ECCV 2018; zllrunning's face-parsing.PyTorch checkpoint as shipped by facexlib): labels skin, brows, eyes, glasses, ears, nose, mouth, lips, neck, cloth, hair and hat in a face crop (19 classes, CelebAMask-HQ). MIT code and weights.

Commercial use: yes.

Details
  • Original code: https://github.com/xinntao/facexlib at 260620ae9399
  • Code licence: MIT (permissive); files: LICENSE
  • Weights licence: MIT
  • Licence evidence: https://github.com/zllrunning/face-parsing.PyTorch/blob/d2e684cf1588b46145635e8fe7bcc29544e5537e/LICENSE ; https://github.com/xinntao/facexlib/blob/260620ae93990a300f4b16448df9bb459f1caba9/LICENSE ; https://github.com/xinntao/facexlib/blob/260620ae93990a300f4b16448df9bb459f1caba9/facexlib/parsing/__init__.py
  • Training data: ImageNet-1k (ILSVRC 2012 classification), CelebAMask-HQ (30 000 CelebA-HQ faces, 19 face-part masks) (face-parsing.PyTorch train.py: CelebAMask-HQ (non-commercial research only), ResNet-18 initialised from torchvision's ImageNet weights.)
  • Kernel libraries: igev, cutlass_conv, cudnn_hacc
  • Variants: bisenet-face-parsing
  • Outputs: logits; label_set: celebamask-hq-19-bisenet
  • Input size: any H x W >= 1, resized or padded inside the model
  • Tested up to (portable, fp16, RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB): bisenet-face-parsing 512x512 (0.0 GiB peak allocated, 0.1 reserved)
  • bisenet-face-parsing 512x512, first call: portable + torch.compile 6 s (cold Inductor cache), TensorRT fp16 13 s (ONNX + engine).
  • bisenet-face-parsing original 512x512: .half() on 1 modules, fp16 inputs; face-parsing.PyTorch test.py: PIL resize 512 x 512 on the CPU, Normalize, net(x)[0], float32
  • bisenet-face-parsing kernels 512x512: Existing CUDA kernel mode on one fixed input with five warm calls.
  • bisenet-face-parsing load / first call: original 0.31 s / 0.405 s (512x512), portable 0.2 s / 0.275 s (512x512), kernels 0.61 s / 0.083 s (512x512)
  • Protocol, first call, 3 warm-up, peak reset, median of 3 rounds x median of 5

Measured

Scores use one pixel confusion matrix across the split. Left and right eyes share one class, and left and right brows share one class. Labels outside the eight shared foreground classes count as background. Original = the original code named under Details, same checkpoint and protocol.

Parity

CPU, float32: max |diff| <= 2.6e-05 vs the original. GPU, float16 (the default), portable and kernels: mean |diff| <= 0.0042 and p99 <= 0.02 (absolute error of the output logits).
